The table gives sessions, processes, samples, exit codes, and process and VM hours, and the cost at list prices. The cost has recorded items with the dates of their plan rows, estimated items, and the total. Sessions by label: sessions of the final freeze, for the main study and FU1 to FU12 (the processes of FU13 to FU21 and the 58 of the memory-limit and warm-cost measurements on the A100, the H100, and the L4 Triton are given in the text); by device: sessions with a process on that device. Process wall h: wall\_seconds of runs.jsonl, including featurization and compilation. VM h: launcher records, VM running to deleted; device rows include FU5 on the CPU row. OOM stops: the planned stops of the memory-limit measurement. Recorded: spend written in the plan rows from the session records (VM running to deleted, list prices, interrupted VMs included). Estimated, not recorded as spend: VM h times cloud/prices.csv for the session's platform, machine type, provisioning and region (europe-west4 where a region has no price). List prices, not a bill; disks, storage and network excluded, as are sessions without a launcher record (pilot 1, engineering), the release VM and the on-premise hosts.
